confirmed_findings.claim: The post-invocation Bash gate against direct reads of injected context files is trivially bypassed by quoting the path or using a relative path, since it only matches the exact shape `cat <absolute-unquoted-path>`, so quoted or relative `cat` commands pass silently.
confirmed_findings.fix: For the Bash case, don't special-case cat's exact argv shape — either resolve the command's arguments against $ctx_dir after normalizing quotes/relative paths (eval set -- in a subshell with cd "$cwd", or argv-parse via python3), or drop the metacharacter allowlist and grep the raw command string for $ctx_dir as a conservative superset.

confirmed_findings.claim: The PreToolUse guard unconditionally denies every write to acdsl/registry.local.json in gated or strict mode, contradicting the README and the authoritative Go overlayViolations check, making it impossible to add a sanctioned local verifier override through Claude Code in any gated/strict repo.
confirmed_findings.fix: Drop acdsl/registry.local.json from the hook's frozen-surface case arm (line 43); either let it fall through to acdsl check's authoritative judgment, or replicate overlayViolations' sanctioned-name check inline via jq against policy.json's local_overrides and the new content.

confirmed_findings.claim: handleSessionsScopeArchive, handleSessionsScopeDelete, and handleSessionsScopeUnarchive set HX-Redirect unconditionally before checking the operation's error, so htmx clients never render the server-side error card on failure — a failed delete looks identical to a successful one in the UI.
confirmed_findings.fix: In all three handlers, set HX-Redirect only in the success branch (mirroring internal/server/repos.go:509's conditional HX-Trigger pattern).
